issues.where: main red growth at center and the left foreground
issues.what: Several dry-looking, finely branched rust-colored tufts replace the dominant, heavy, right-sweeping clump with its thick exposed roots and long fleshy strands. The small front tuft competes with the hero instead of framing it.
issues.fix: Build one dominant, thick-rooted clump with irregular long red ribbons sweeping to the right, and put the subsidiary growth back along the left edge.

issues.where: right foreground ledge and the drop behind it
issues.what: Broad, clean, nearly flat shelves run across the front right and obscure the steep opening. The far cliff also sits higher and reads larger. The target has a lower irregular wet perch, a visible dark drop at right and a softer far wall.
issues.fix: Lower and break up the near shelves, reopen the drop beside the plant, and set the far cliff back and lower in frame.

issues.where: right half of the pit and distant cliff base
issues.what: Cool gray haze forms a broad horizontal blanket rather than warm, localized plumes rising from the shadowed opening. The uniform veil flattens the depth.
issues.fix: Break the haze into gently backlit rising wisps, with clear pockets that reveal the dark pit and its shelves.

issues.what: The overhanging mass of red growth, dangling tips and close rock that frame the target are largely gone; distant dark clumps and exposed terraces take their place.
issues.fix: Bring a close red clump back over the left edge, with wet pendant tips and a near ledge below it. Restore a few smaller red clumps on the far rim.

issues.what: The pit reads as a wider, more open amphitheater of thin jagged benches and repetitive fluted walls. The target's closer right wall has broad rounded bands curving into the pit and a large pale broken slab angled across a mid-level shelf; the replacement instead puts prominent brown blocks around multiple shelves and the right edge.
issues.fix: Pull the right-wall arcs closer, thicken and round their profiles, restore the pale leaning slab on the middle-right shelf, and reduce the oversized front-right rubble.

issues.what: A gray veil is spread through much of the pit, lifting the shadows while leaving deep terraces uniformly legible. The target has defined steam columns interrupting the view and a much darker core.
issues.fix: Concentrate warmer steam into rising, semi-transparent billows toward the left and center, leaving clear intervals and deeper shadow below and to the right.

issues.where: top strip and light on the rim
issues.what: The much more prominent pale far slope and muted water strip replace a low expanse of reflective flats, while the pale sunset lacks the strong warm glints that link the horizon, wet rim and foreground in the target.
issues.fix: Give the marsh flats more visible depth, mute and recede the far slope, and restore the low upper-left gold reflection and grazing highlights.

issues.where: central fronds and upper-right tips, shown in set-B-02.png
issues.what: The fronds have broadly matte copper edges and lack the target's luminous red transmission, sharp wet glints and hanging or free-falling drops. This is a material and lighting difference, not a loss of sharpness from motion.
issues.fix: Backlight thinner red material on its upper-left side and add wet highlights, beads and pendant drops along the longer fronds.

issues.where: base of the main clump and lower foreground
issues.what: The ledge reads as coarse bare dark rock rather than the target's mixed warm stone, damp grit, rounded pebbles, shallow runoff and pale bone-like debris.
issues.fix: Vary the rock and grit scale at the root line, add pale debris and pebbles, and give the irregular wet surfaces small gold reflections.

issues.where: reflective flats in the upper-left background
issues.what: Several small dark silhouettes are scattered along the left and the prominent pale long-necked wader left of center is lost as a clear scale cue.
issues.fix: Restore one readable, softly backlit long-necked silhouette left of center and keep any other distant figures quiet.

issues.where: upper rim and middle-right shelves, shown in set-B-04.png
issues.what: The gray-brown rock looks uniformly dry and smoothly smeared on surfaces that should be static. It lacks the target's pale glossy mineral crust, ochre flow marks, dark green damp patches and fine wet streaks below the lip.
issues.fix: Add distinct cream crust and ochre deposits over darker green-gray wall material, sharpen static texture and cracks, and add localized glossy runoff and drips.

issues.what: Too many tall, thin-necked figures are strung along the waterline; several near the left edge look taller and closer than the target's sparse small waders.
issues.fix: Thin and spread the group across the flats, place the clearest figures farther back, and keep their reflections and highlights subtle.
